_documentation: The PERMANENT identity of the durable directory (ADR 0065). This template is deliberately INCOMPLETE: copying it changes nothing, and the durable path refuses until you fill in `identity`, `services` and `network`, naming every key that is still missing. That refusal is the point -- the domain SID and every account SID derive from the realm and the NetBIOS name, so a silent fallback to the synthetic acceptance identity (ad.factory.test / FACTORY) would provision a permanent domain under a name nobody chose, and there is no rename afterwards, only a migration. The acceptance gates never read this file and are unaffected by it. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation and are ignored by the loader; every other unknown key is refused. See README.md beside this file.

network.prefix: <prefix-length: a JSON NUMBER, not a string>
